We need infer circuit topology and resistor values from many node-to-node resistance measurements. Likely it's a complete graph of nodes with resistors in series/parallel? Might be a ladder network? Nodes: A, B, N_b1, N_c1, N_c2, N_c3, N_d1, N_d2, N_d3, X1, X2, X3. Many measurements given. Probably the circuit is a series of resistors between A and B with intermediate nodes? Resistances between A and B is 125. Between A and N_b1 is 11.667, between N_b1 and B is 113.333 (sum 125). So N_b1 is a node on series path from A to B with R_A_Nb1 = 11.667, R_Nb1_B = 113.333. Similarly A to X1 is 6.667, X1 to B is 118.333 (sum 125). So X1 also on series path. So many nodes are points along same series line? Check A to N_c1 =30, B to N_c1 =95 (sum 125). So all nodes lie on same series line between A and B. So the circuit is a simple series resistor chain from A to B with multiple intermediate nodes. Resistances between successive nodes unknown. We have many nodes; need to infer individual segment resistances.

Let’s list nodes in order from A to B based on increasing resistance from A: smallest A-X1 6.667, then A-N_b1 11.667, then A-X2 25, then A-N_c1 30, then A-N_c2 40, then A-X3 75, then A-N_d1 80, A-N_d2 90, A-N_d3 105, A-B 125.

But order must be monotonic. Let's sort: A-X1 (6.667), A-N_b1 (11.667), A-X2 (25), A-N_c1 (30), A-N_c2 (40), A-N_d1 (80) but we have A-X3 75 before 80, so X3 75, then N_d1 80, N_d2 90, N_d3 105, B 125.

Thus nodes in order: A - X1 - N_b1 - X2 - N_c1 - N_c2 - X3 - N_d1 - N_d2 - N_d3 - B.

Now we can compute segment resistances as differences: R_A_X1 =6.667. R_X1_Nb1 = 11.667-6.667=5.0 (matches measurement N_b1-X1 =5.0). Good. R_Nb1_X2 =25-11.667=13.333 (matches Nb1-X2 13.333). R_X2_Nc1 =30-25=5.0 (matches Nc1-X2 5.0). R_Nc1_Nc2 =40-30=10.0 (matches Nc1-Nc2 10). R_Nc2_X3 =75-40=35.0 (matches Nc2-X3 35). R_X3_Nd1 =80-75=5.0 (matches Nd1-X3 5). R_Nd1_Nd2 =90-80=10 (matches Nd1-Nd2 10). R_Nd2_Nd3 =105-90=15 (matches Nd2-Nd3 15). R_Nd3_B =125-105=20 (matches Nd3-B 20). All consistent.

Thus resistor values: R1 between A and X1 =6.667, R2 X1-Nb1 =5, R3 Nb1-X2=13.333, R4 X2-Nc1=5, R5 Nc1-Nc2=10, R6 Nc2-X3=35, R7 X3-Nd1=5, R8 Nd1-Nd2=10, R9 Nd2-Nd3=15, R10 Nd3-B=20.

We need output JSON with resistors and connections. Use names R1...R10.

Connections list each as [node1,node2, resistorName].

Let's construct.
